concept: A nail atelier; colour picker and booking.

shots.title: Hero still life
shots.prompt: Luxury beauty still life of nail polish bottles of original design in a row with a colour swatch wheel, on a sculpted stone plinth, soft directional light and long shadows, negative space on one side for a headline. Original packaging, no text on it. Overall look: glossy beauty photography, pastel, macro; colour palette of blush, lilac, cream, chrome. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.

shots.title: Product packshots
shots.camera: Packshot, same angle and light in every cell
shots.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four separate photographs separated by thin white gutters, all four in one consistent style and light. Original packaging designs, no text. Overall look: glossy beauty photography, pastel, macro; colour palette of blush, lilac, cream, chrome. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
